---
title: Validation & Benchmarks
---

Comparisons of NumCosmo against the Core Cosmology Library (CCL), validating
agreement on key observables, and against values certified in arbitrary
precision, which establish accuracy rather than agreement.

- [CCL Background](ccl_background.qmd) --- background expansion and distances.
- [CCL Power Spectrum](ccl_power_spectrum.qmd) --- linear and nonlinear matter power spectra.
- [CCL Two-Point Correlation](ccl_two_point.qmd) --- angular two-point statistics.
- [Certified Radial Projection](xcor_certified_projection.qmd) --- the radial
  integral $I_\ell(k)$ against Arb, including the redshift-space weight, with
  CCL's non-Limber method on the same certified values.
- [Angular Power Spectrum Derivatives](xcor_derivatives.qmd) --- the same
  clustering spectrum from UltraLevin and from CCL's FKEM, and its derivative
  with respect to $\Omega_c$ taken with `NcmDiff` on both: agreement on the
  spectrum does not carry over to the derivative.
